description: Token-skipping can pass a noncontiguous state view to a stride-unaware histogram kernel.
trigger: Multiple state rows, positive skip_tokens smaller than the context length, and state already on the selected device so no copying materializes the slice.
expected_behavior: Histogram every element of the selected token suffixes.
actual_behavior: inspect_state does not make the slice contiguous. The native kernel traverses input_ptr[0:numel], ignoring row gaps, so it can include skipped tokens from later rows and omit selected trailing tokens.

verification.description: The parent has no inspect_state caller; the new main calls it after each module forward. Traced its slice through histogram to raw-pointer CUDA indexing.
verification.limits: Conditional on the view retaining row strides; device-copy behavior was not executed.

verification.description: Modeled a contiguous [2,3,2] tensor with one skipped token per row: selected values sum to 52, whereas contiguous pointer traversal from the slice offset sums to 44.
verification.limits: Python indexing model, not Torch or CUDA execution.

verification.description: Compared the unchanged slice and raw-pointer kernel with main's newly gated direct call. The defect remains conditional within the selected interval; no_inspect_modules does not disable this call.
verification.limits: Literal search establishes the located direct caller, not external callers or actual device-copy behavior.

verification.description: Modeled a contiguous [2,3,2] array with one skipped token per row. Selected elements sum to 52; contiguous traversal from the slice offset sums to 44.
verification.limits: Python indexing model only; neither Torch slicing nor the CUDA implementation ran.

finding.description: Selected hidden-state inspections retain the inherited mismatch between sliced tensor strides and contiguous native histogram traversal.
finding.trigger: An inspected state has multiple rows and a positive skip_tokens smaller than the context length, and conversion to the selected device leaves the sliced view's row gaps intact.
finding.expected_behavior: Histogram all and only the selected token suffixes from every row.
finding.actual_behavior: inspect_state does not request contiguity. histogram_kernel reads input_ptr[i] for numel elements without consulting strides, potentially counting skipped tokens from subsequent rows while omitting selected trailing elements.
